source.title: Zoho MCP Tool Manual
source.capture_method: Read the public interactive Tool List tables by service; retained service names and tool-name rows only.
excluded_fields: identity, account, authorization, and tenant data
source.annotation_rule: Remove an exact leading service qualifier when the provider embeds one in the operation key, then replace underscores with spaces and insert a space at lowercase-or-digit to uppercase boundaries; preserve all other source casing and hyphens. The exact provider operation key remains unchanged.
source.publication_basis: Rendered Tool List rows, whose total matches the Tool Manual homepage counter.
source.search_index_note: Bundle search arrays contain 10,868 rows and conflict with rendered Tool Lists for Analytics, Apptics, and Catalyst. This catalog uses rendered Tool List cells only.

interpretation: Catalog presence does not prove Sylvara selection, authorization, tenant access, plan availability, callability, or safe semantics.
Service plus operation key is the qualified technical identity; annotated tool names never contain a service or server prefix.
Duplicate source rows are preserved in source order and identified by source_row.
